command:
set -eu
member_uid=$(id -u nobody)
outsider_gid=$(id -g nobody)
platform_gid=$(getent group platform | cut -d: -f3)
member_file=/srv/platform/.member-access-proof
outsider_file=/srv/platform/.outsider-access-proof
test ! -e "$member_file"
test ! -e "$outsider_file"
setpriv --reuid="$member_uid" --regid="$platform_gid" --clear-groups -- sh -c 'umask 0002; printf member-created > "$1"; printf -- "-and-updated\n" >> "$1"' sh "$member_file"
printf 'member_create_and_update=allowed\n'
stat -Lc 'member_file owner_uid=%u group=%G mode=%a size=%s' "$member_file"
if setpriv --reuid="$member_uid" --regid="$outsider_gid" --clear-groups -- sh -c 'printf outsider-created > "$1"' sh "$outsider_file" 2>/tmp/platform-outsider.err; then
  printf 'outsider_create=unexpectedly_allowed\n'
  exit 1
else
  printf 'outsider_create=denied\n'
  sed -n '1p' /tmp/platform-outsider.err
fi
setpriv --reuid="$member_uid" --regid="$platform_gid" --clear-groups -- rm -f "$member_file"
test ! -e "$member_file"
test ! -e "$outsider_file"
printf 'test_artifacts=clean\n'

command:

proof=/srv/platform/.restart-persistence-proof
member_uid=$(id -u nobody)
platform_gid=$(getent group platform | cut -d: -f3)
outsider_gid=$(id -g nobody)
test ! -e "$proof"
setpriv --reuid="$member_uid" --regid="$platform_gid" --clear-groups -- sh -c 'umask 0002; printf "platform-workspace-persistence-v1\n" > "$1"' sh "$proof"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
getent group platform
stat -Lc 'workspace path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/platform
stat -Lc 'proof path=%n owner_uid=%u group=%G mode=%a size=%s' "$proof"
sha256sum "$proof"
setpriv --reuid="$member_uid" --regid="$platform_gid" --clear-groups -- sh -c 'test -r "$1" && test -w "$1"' sh "$proof"
